title: Desktop files
whyItMatters: Whatever was left on the desktop: documents, photos, screenshots, exports and shortcuts. File names alone often reveal health, money, family and work details.
source: Windows known folder Desktop, default path under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: If OneDrive Known Folder Move is on, the real Desktop is %USERPROFILE% OneDrive Desktop and this folder may be empty or a stub; both are counted separately. The Desktop folder of every user on the PC is the user-profiles rules' job.
